pr_title: sql: implement DESCENDING order PKs for row-level TTL
pr_body:
Fixes #76912

Updates the schema change validation to allow TTL tables to have DESC PK columns. The functionality is version gated behind `V23_2TTLAllowDescPK`.

Changes the TTL query bounds `WHERE` clause from this format:
```
AND (col1, col2) >= ($4, $5) AND (col1, col2) < ($2, $3)
```
to this format:
```
AND (
  (col1 > $4) OR
  (col1 = $4 AND col2 >= $5)
)
AND (
  (col1 < $2) OR
  (col1 = $2 AND col2 < $3)
)

```
which allows for DESC order keys:
```
AND (
  (col1 < $4) OR
  (col1 = $4 AND col2 <= $5)
)
AND (
  (col1 > $2) OR
  (col1 = $2 AND col2 > $3)
)
```
or mixed ASC/DESC order keys:
```
AND (
  (col1 > $4) OR
  (col1 = $4 AND col2 <= $5)
)
AND (
  (col1 < $2) OR
  (col1 = $2 AND col2 > $3)
)
```

The `ORDER BY` clause also replaces implicit ascending ordering:
```
ORDER BY col1, col2
```
with explicit ordering:
```
ORDER BY col1 ASC, col2 DESC
```

Release note (sql change): TTL supports DESC order primay key columns.

Depends on
~https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pull/102030~
~https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pull/102127~

I added `ASC -> DESC -> ASC` and `DESC -> ASC -> DESC` tests for this now. A `DESC` column just reverses the `>` and `<` for start and end bounds checks from an `ASC` column.

> * how does this go with PKs that look like `PRIMARY KEY (id ASC, id2 ASC, id3 ASC)`? what kind of queries get generated? because now you have to do `(id > 2) OR (id == 2 and id2 > 3) OR (id ==d && id2 == 3 && id3 > 4)`. not sure i see any tests for it. is the optimiser smart enough to figure out that kind of query is a range scan?

issue_context.title: sql: implement DESCENDING order PKs for row-level TTL
issue_context.body:
Currently row-level TTL tables only allow ascending order PKs.

This is because it is easier to write the pagination expression `(col1, col2, ...) > (pk1, pk2, ...)`. Supporting mixed directions is trickier and hence disabled for now.

Jira issue: CRDB-13391
Epic CRDB-18322
